name: Hall Projection after Two Independent Corner Moves
definition: The 232-word family in `combined_corner_moves.json`, obtained from Hall's coordinate-zero projection by the six recorded legal maximum-class exchanges.
properties: It is maximum of VC dimension three in $Q_{11}$ and has exactly the two corners 1537 and 2023, at Hamming distance six. The first three exchanges move one original corner and the last three move the other while every intermediate family remains a two-corner maximum class.
